data.one_liner: A customizable video player widget that adds controls, fullscreen, caching and quality switching on top of video_player.
data.what_it_does: Wraps the official video_player and provides a fully customisable control bar, fullscreen mode, video caching and quality selection. It also adds gestures for volume control and mute/unmute features.
use_when: You need a video player with a custom UI and advanced controls
You want built‑in caching of network videos
You require fullscreen support and quality switching across Android, iOS and Web
avoid_when: You only need basic video playback without extra UI
You are targeting platforms where video_player is not supported
weaknesses: Adds an extra abstraction layer over video_player
Potentially more bugs than the core video_player
Limited to video – no audio‑only features
data.setup_notes: Add cached_video_player and video_player to pubspec, create a standard VideoPlayerController then wrap it with CustomVideoPlayerController, no special native permissions required

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides basic video playback with fewer dependencies if you don't need custom controls or caching
